lines.cap: Counting sheep doesn't work. Here's what does.
lines.say: Counting sheep doesn't work. Here's what does.

lines.cap: Midnight. You can't sleep. So you start counting. One sheep. Two sheep. Three.
lines.say: Midnight. You can't sleep. So you start counting. One sheep. Two sheep. Three.

lines.cap: In 2002, Oxford researchers tested it on people with insomnia.
lines.say: In 2002, Oxford researchers tested it on people with insomnia.

lines.cap: The sheep counters took slightly longer to fall asleep than people who did nothing special.
lines.say: The sheep counters took slightly longer to fall asleep than people who did nothing special.

lines.cap: Counting is just too boring to block out your worries. The thoughts sneak back in.
lines.say: Counting is just too boring to block out your worries. The thoughts sneak back in.

lines.cap: What worked better: imagining a calm, detailed scene. A waterfall. A beach. The sounds, the light, the temperature.
lines.say: What worked better: imagining a calm, detailed scene. A waterfall. A beach. The sounds, the light, the temperature.

lines.cap: That group fell asleep about twenty minutes faster than usual.
lines.say: That group fell asleep about twenty minutes faster than usual.

lines.cap: So tonight, forget the sheep. Go to the beach.
lines.say: So tonight, forget the sheep. Go to the beach.
